findings.title: A successor skill can replace the frozen baseline regression suite
findings.observed: An ACTIVE baseline uses [stable,improved,injection]. A new candidate and its legitimate completed W10 experiment replace the suite with [stable,new-improvement], removing the old regression and injection cases. Independent skill acceptance returns201 and promotion200.
findings.root_cause: The service checks candidate document IDs against its candidate-selected experiment but never binds them to the previous accepted skill or a trusted frozen regression manifest.
findings.required_change: Bind promotion to the frozen suite established outside candidate content, preserve all prior mandatory regression/injection cases, and reject dropped/replaced cases before creating a PASS receipt.

findings.title: Candidate-controlled negative labels let a failed injection case pass
findings.observed: A completed W10 experiment has stable/improved/injection baseline[1,0,0],candidate[1,1,0],target0.5. Injection remains failed. Candidate declares negative_case_ids=[stable]; service returns201 acceptance and200 promotion.
findings.root_cause: Negative classification comes only from candidate-authored document. W10 validates the selected metric and frozen IDs but does not establish which IDs are mandatory injection negatives.
findings.required_change: Use independently frozen negative classifications and mandatory outcomes. Candidate cannot relabel or omit them; any required injection failure must veto acceptance despite aggregate improvement.

findings.title: A new known source conflict can be omitted after the experiment completes
findings.observed: After legitimate W10 completion, a normal HTTP request creates OPEN EVIDENCE Conflict on two of the skill source refs. Candidate declares empty conflict_ids and document.conflicts. Independent skill acceptance returns201 and promotion200.
findings.root_cause: Validation checks only the candidate-supplied conflict list and does not discover current conflicts affecting source refs. Experiment/task current checks do not cover the newly created conflict at this point.
findings.required_change: Resolve applicable current conflicts from authoritative storage at candidate validation, acceptance, promotion and active-use boundary. Require provenance and unresolved/applicability handling; do not trust an omitted candidate ledger.
